text: June 2026: we gave a Burleigh Waters unit complex a low-pressure exterior wash. Black mould streaked the brick walls, and moss and dirt sat on the pavers, worst around the stairwells. Mid-job, a brick gable wall showed a clear line between the cleaner lower section and the duller top.
alt: Large brick gable wall with a visible tone line between cleaner lower and duller upper sections in Burleigh Waters
